name: ScrollVelocity-TS-TW
blurb: Text scrolls horizontally, accelerating and reversing direction based on page scroll speed.
description: Renders multiple looping text rows that move horizontally. Scroll velocity controls speed and direction; alternating rows move in opposite directions. Uses motion/react with spring damping.
use_when: A full-width marquee section wants dynamic responsiveness to user scroll behavior.
avoid_when: When horizontal text flow might conflict with reading direction or cause motion sickness.
a11y: Text is duplicated for continuous loop effect; each copy is readable but not linearized for screen readers.
